enmo_hourly_median_mean_g.daily_statistic: sum(hourly_median * n_windows) / sum(n_windows); NOT pooled window median

walking_cadence_hourly_median_mean_hz.hourly_statistic: median(2*50/stride_lag) on walking windows in Mew 37d5722
walking_cadence_hourly_median_mean_hz.daily_statistic: sum(hourly_median * n_walk) / sum(n_walk); NOT pooled walking median

rest_tremor_window_fraction.daily_statistic: sum(n_tremor) / sum(n_rest); NOT mean of hourly ratios

method.weight: each eligible subject has total weight 1/N; each day weight 1/(N*days_for_subject_and_metric)
method.quantile: inverse weighted empirical CDF, first cumulative mass >= q; no interpolation
method.mad: weighted median(abs(value - weighted median)) with the same subject-balanced weights
method.train_scoring: exclude ALL days of the scored train subject and refit subject weights and summary
method.interpretation: signed distance from a cohort reference, not severity, diagnostic probability or a combined score
